name: hint
title: Hint
description: A hint text component for form fields with icon, error, disabled states, and composed mode. Uses namespace exports: Hint.Root, Hint.Icon, Hint.Composed.

migration.guide: v3 replaces the inline SVG default icon with RiInformationFill from @remixicon/react. Hint.Icon now defaults to RiInformationFill when no `as` prop is provided, so `<Hint.Icon />` works without passing an icon. Hint.DefaultIcon export has been removed.

docs.lead: A hint text component for form fields with icon support, error/disabled states, and a composed shorthand. Defaults to RiInformationFill icon.
docs.usage:
import * as Hint from "@/components/ui/hint"

<Hint.Root>
  <Hint.Icon />
  This is a hint text.
</Hint.Root>

examples.title: Demo
examples.description: Hint with default icon and text.
examples.code:
<Hint.Root>
  <Hint.Icon />
  This is a hint text to help user.
</Hint.Root>

examples.title: Disabled
examples.code:
<Hint.Root disabled>
  <Hint.Icon />
  This is a hint text to help user.
</Hint.Root>

examples.title: Has Error
examples.code:
<Hint.Root hasError>
  <Hint.Icon />
  This is a hint text to help user.

examples.title: Custom Icon
examples.description: Hint with a custom icon via the `as` prop.
examples.code:
<Hint.Root>
  <Hint.Icon as={RiAlertFill} />
  This hint uses a custom icon.
</Hint.Root>

examples.title: Composed
examples.description: Props-driven hint with default icon, error, and disabled states.
examples.code:
<Hint.Composed>This is a hint with default icon.</Hint.Composed>

<Hint.Composed icon={RiAlertFill}>
  This is a hint with custom icon.
</Hint.Composed>

<Hint.Composed hasError>This hint has an error.</Hint.Composed>

<Hint.Composed disabled>This hint is disabled.</Hint.Composed>

api.name: Hint.Icon
api.description: Icon displayed before the hint text. Defaults to RiInformationFill.

api.name: Hint.Composed
api.description: Props-driven hint with a built-in default icon. Pass custom icon via the icon prop.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon component. Defaults to RiInformationFill.
